purpose: Overlay art for asset id art.map.overlay.obscurement-light.v1 (Mechanical overlay: obscurement light); composited over floor cells by the classic renderer to show the mechanical state 'obscurement-light'. This is a REDO: the delivered asset replaces the current file one-for-one at promotion.
prompt: Mechanical board overlay tile: lightly obscured area: a sparse translucent mist veil. Semantic marker art drawn over a floor tile: high legibility at 1:1, restrained palette, translucent where a veil is described, crisp 1:1 pixels, no text.
negativePrompt: photograph, 3D render, isometric perspective, blur, anti-aliasing, smooth gradients, text, watermark, signature, border, frame

style.summary: Matches the repository's classic-board pixel art: 128 x 128 top-down tile, crisp 1:1 pixels, flat stepped shading with light from the top-left, shadows shifting toward blue-violet and lights toward yellow, the generated palette of eight hue ramps (stone, wood, earth, moss, cloth-warm, cloth-cool, metal, skin) plus cool-grey neutrals.
style.palette: Generated ramp palette, see src/assets/palette.ts; keep to the same hue families as the current asset.

background.notes: Transparent background; the marker or veil carries partial alpha so the floor stays readable beneath it.

acceptanceCriteria: File is a PNG, exactly 128 x 128, 8-bit RGBA.
Composition, footprint and transparency class match the current map-overlay-obscurement-light-v1.png so the file is a drop-in replacement (same name at promotion).
Pixels are crisp: no anti-aliased edges, no smooth gradients; a 4x nearest-neighbour zoom shows only hard-edged pixels.
No text, signature, watermark, border or frame.
Meaning of 'obscurement-light' is recognisable at 1:1 and distinct from every other overlay in public/assets/art/map-overlay-*.png.
The floor tile remains readable through the overlay (veils translucent, markers not filling the whole cell opaquely).
notes: Part of batch redo-starter-art-v1: a redo of every starter art asset. Recipe from src/assets/starter-art-inputs.ts: {"kind": "overlay", "material": "semantic", "effect": "obscurement-light"}.
